WITH equipment_averages AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
), reference_averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS all_equipment_avg
  FROM equipment_averages
), kept AS (
  SELECT ea.equipref,
         ea.avg_humidity,
         ea.avg_humidity - ra.all_equipment_avg AS excess
  FROM equipment_averages AS ea
  CROSS JOIN reference_averages AS ra
  WHERE ra.all_equipment_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND ea.avg_humidity > ra.all_equipment_avg
), kept_reference AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS kept_avg
  FROM kept
), ranked AS (
  SELECT k.equipref,
         k.avg_humidity,
         k.excess,
         k.avg_humidity - kr.kept_avg AS difference_from_kept_mean
  FROM kept AS k
  CROSS JOIN kept_reference AS kr
  WHERE kr.kept_avg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT equipref,
       avg_humidity,
       excess,
       difference_from_kept_mean
FROM ranked
ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10 WITH TIES;

assumptions.assumption: The all-equipment average is the unweighted average of each equipment reference's non-NULL humidity average; equipment with no non-NULL readings is excluded. The kept-group mean is likewise the unweighted average of the kept equipment averages.
Use SQLite's LIMIT 10 WITH TIES syntax to include every row tied with the tenth row under the requested sort order.
